turns.speaker: PATRON
turns.text: I requested a book return extension yesterday but the website still says overdue.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I forgot to save the extension after we spoke. I can see it here as pending, and I am sorry.

turns.speaker: PATRON
turns.text: Please confirm when that is fixed.

evidence.text: Account notes confirm staff may extend the loan, but the requested extension remained unsaved; systems recorded no outage.

turns.speaker: PATRON
turns.text: Why has my reservation been cancelled twice?

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The reservation will not go through, but I do not have any more detail in my screen.

evidence.text: The catalogue system returned intermittent failures to all staff during the requested period. No workaround was authorised.
